task.title: Pin the content of the web client's fallback card view
task.description:
The web client's fallback card view (underivedView, internal/webui/assets/index.html ~:2846) renders a card for exactly one poll when a task is deleted by another clone mid-drag (the crash fix from PR #89). Its deliberate content choices -- the full task ID as the prefix, and NO dependency row (the client cannot know which dependencies are done, so "0 of 3" over three finished ones would be a worse lie than one blank poll) -- are pinned by nothing.

Verified during PR #89's review: replacing the function body with garbage (idPrefix "", dependenciesTotal 9, waitingOnDependencies true) leaves the entire internal/webui suite green, because the Node-harness fixtures make the fallback indistinguishable from the derived view.

Fix: extend TestHandlerClientSurvivesATaskDeletedMidDrag (internal/webui/handler_test.go) with assertions on the fallback card's rendered content during the one-poll window: full-ID prefix shown, no dependency row present. Test-only change; no production code.

Edge case: reaching the fallback at all requires a task deleted by another clone while its card is mid-drag in this browser.
